content: The Zendesk row-colouring extension space is thinly populated but NOT empty. Zest - The Zendesk Colour Coder (kohidmaedanhmmhkhkbeaonheneldfbi): 1,000 users, 5.0/5 from 5 ratings, v1.3 updated 2026-04-15, MV3, permissions ['storage'] only, no data collection declared. Colour-codes rows by ANY column value, not just priority; requires per-category configuration via popup AND a manual page refresh to apply changes. Zendesk Priority Highlights (kdnlbgealinpnebnoamnabcpjkifokpk): the exact same product concept as Zhroma (red/orange/yellow/green by Urgent/High/Normal/Low), 87 installs, 3.71/5 from 7 votes, last updated 2019-07-21, DELISTED 2026-08-27 with a flagged policy violation and no privacy policy. Boost Focus - Zendesk Highlighter (eghahjbmnoekjcehalmfloddcjnnedic): ~51 users, now paywalled/abandoned ('Subscription Required... Contact Karan to reactivate access'). Adjacent Zendesk extensions are all small single-dev tools: Zendesk Utils 887 users 4.5/5 (auto-refresh, hide views, who-is-editing; NOT colour coding), Zendesk Plus 227 users, Zendesk Enhancer 201 users 1 rating, Zendesk Dark Mode 849 users but only 2.6/5 and last updated 2022, Zendesk Helper, ZenNotifier, Zendesk Tab Manager. Zendesk Marketplace alternative: Super Views, a paid ZAF app that REPLACES the native ticket list with its own iframe-rendered table offering 1000 tickets/view, multi-column sort, colour coding and CSV export.
